beats.actTitle: Act I — Low-Vibes Bad Coffee Crime Scene
beats.camera: Slow ominous dolly-in (1.00x -> 1.06x) onto cold 7:02 AM kitchen counter spotlighting a $24 'Ethiopia Guji: Jasmine & White Peach' bag next to a steaming mug of murky sludge
beats.headline: Spent $24 on "Jasmine & White Peach."
beats.punchlineCaption: Why does your 7 AM mug taste like a 9-volt battery?
beats.beanjaminAction: Peeks nervously from behind the $24 coffee bag in cold slate lighting, blinking rapidly at the toxic green-grey steam

beats.actTitle: Act I — Low-Vibes Bad Coffee Crime Scene
beats.camera: Snap 1.14x macro punch-in onto the sad mug with micro camera-shake shiver on the slurp at 2.35s
beats.headline: Brewed Notes of Battery Acid & Burnt Tires.
beats.punchlineCaption: Somehow sour AND bitter in the exact same sip. Science is crying.
beats.beanjaminAction: Full comedic horror recoil: paws clap to cheeks, eyes wide, sour-green & burnt-charcoal fume icons rise from the cup
